card.name: Dose word after starting or initial
card.fires_on: The word dose, dosage or the start of Dosage, right after starting, initial or recommended. It is seen in label dosing sections, often for pediatric or impaired patients.

modes.label: Starting dose wording
modes.description: Dose or dosage right after starting or initial, just before an amount is given.

card.plain: It lights up on the word dose or dosage when a label is about to give the starting amount.
